_meanings:
.²1 A sacrificial altar or ground; {#iti priye vAdini vedikodarI#} <ls>Rām. Ch. 2. 57</ls>.
.²2 A raised seat; an elevated spot of ground (usually for sacred purposes);
 {#saptaparRavedikA#} <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; {#sadevadArudrumavedikAyAm#} <ls>Ku. 3. 44</ls>.
.²3 A seat in general.
.²4 An altar, a heap, mound; {#mandAkinIsEkatavedikABiH#} <ls>Ku. 1. 29</ls> ‘by
 making altars or heaps of sand <ab>&c.</ab>’.
.²5 A quadrangular open shed in the middle of a court-yard; a pavilion,
 balcony; {#taptakAYcanavedikam#} ({#jagrAha#}); <ls>Rām. 7. 15. 37</ls>; {#suraveSmavedikA#} <ls>Ki. 7. 12</ls>.
.²6 An arbour, a bower.
